summary: New York City area resident, software developer with a focus on programming languages (Scala, Clojure, Lisp), strong advocate for open-source software, passionate about robotics and technology innovation, critical of Microsoft and its market dominance, interested in high-speed rail and public transportation improvements, actively learning Spanish, has developed an Android app for language learning, engaged in discussions about education reform and corporate responsibility, frequent contributor to technical forums like StackOverflow, emphasizes the importance of community-driven knowledge sharing in programming.
